name: AUSD
who_can_redeem: Verified customers that satisfy Agora onboarding and eligibility requirements may mint and redeem directly with an Agora entity under the published terms.
redemption_region_notes: Direct minting and redemption depend on verified-customer status, jurisdiction, compliance eligibility, supported settlement rails, and current Agora terms.
redemption_notes: Agora describes AUSD as redeemable at par and fully reserved. Direct issuer redemption is not treated as universally available to every holder because the published terms require verified-customer status.
summary: U.S.-dollar stablecoin issued by Agora Bermuda Limited, described by Agora as fully reserved and redeemable at par with reserves including short-term U.S. Treasuries, overnight repo, cash, and other liquid assets.
notes: Record Growth 119→300 Batch AD. Exact first mint and complete historical deployment chronology remain explicit known unknowns.
